question: As part of your Workspace ONE deployment, you will be enrolling new Multiuser Windows devices for “hot seat” call center users, where users may use different devices each day. Currently, applications deployed to these devices include common apps that are accessible to all users. A new application that installs into the HKLM registry hive must be deployed, which should only be accessible by managers, regardless of which hot seat is occupied on that day. Which of the following deployment options should you select? A. Install Context = User; Admin Privileges = Admin; Permissions = Call Center Managers Smart Group B. Install Context = Device; Admin Privileges = Admin; Permissions = Call Center Managers Smart Group C. Install Context = User; Admin Privileges = User; Permissions = Call Center Managers Smart Group D. Install Context = Device; Admin Privileges = User; Permissions = Call Center Managers Smart Group

DRAG DROP You have been tasked to install AirWatch Cloud Connector on the prepared Windows Server. The connector is required to leverage the outbound proxy for the SaaS connectivity. Click-and-drag to sort the steps below in the correct order to successfully install the connector.

Your organization utilizes a publicly available Android application. Due to a critical security update, you want to ensure that devices receive the app update as quickly as possible. Which of the following actions are recommended? A. Change the assignment type of the app from Optional to Required. B. Change the app delivery method from On-Demand to Auto. C. Upload the new version of the application and set the delivery method to Critical. D. Re-publish the app in UEM and enable Force Install on Next Check-in. E. Set the update priority to High Priority.
